Attached Form 12
Enforcement Rule of the Act on the Promotion of and Support for Environmental Education [Attached Form 12] <Amended on October 1, 2025>

APPLICATION FOR DESIGNATION OF THE NATIONAL ENVIRONMENTAL EDUCATION CENTER

Receipt number: __________
Date of receipt: __________
Processing date: __________
Processing period: 30 days

Applicant
Institution name: __________
Representative: __________
Address: __________
Telephone number: __________
Mobile telephone number: __________
Email address: __________

Application details
Name of the environmental education center: __________
Representative: __________
Location of the environmental education center: __________
Telephone number: __________
Scheduled opening date: __________

I hereby apply for designation of the National Environmental Education Center under Article 24(1) of the Act on the Promotion of and Support for Environmental Education, Article 18(2) of its Enforcement Decree, and Article 11(2) of its Enforcement Rule.

Year ____ Month ____ Day ____
Applicant: __________ (signature or seal)

To: Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment or Minister of Oceans and Fisheries

Accompanying documents
1. Documents proving compliance with the requirements in Appendix 2 of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Promotion of and Support for Environmental Education.
2. One copy of the operating plan for the National Environmental Education Center.

Fee: None

Processing procedure
Preparation of the application → Receipt → Verification → Approval → Issuance of the certificate of designation of the National Environmental Education Center.

Applicant: preparation of the application.
Processing authority: Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment (department responsible for environmental education) or Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries (department responsible for environmental education).
